premises.text: Churn Labs builds speculative products in under-explored tech areas to learn and find opportunities
premises.evidence_span: looking at areas of technology that we think haven't really been fully explored

premises.text: Non-stop Gnomes: unique digital gnome lives on one device, travels via photos/check-ins, and can be handed to friends
premises.evidence_span: a gnome can only live on one device

premises.text: Users create custom gnomes or 'lift' them between devices with camera viewfinder magic transfer
premises.evidence_span: transfer your gnome to a new friend. We're calling this process lift

premises.text: Prior holders get travel notifications, photos, and can comment along the gnome's path
premises.evidence_span: everybody who's been along that path with Disrupt will actually get to comment and join in the fun

premises.text: Lyft/Lift interconnectivity enables drag-and-drop of content through screens between devices
premises.evidence_span: a way of doing a different way of device interconnectivity

value.text: Playful unique digital objects that travel between people and devices while exploring new interconnectivity
value.evidence_span: wouldn't it be cool to have a gnome in your pocket

secondary_value.text: Learn from greenfield experiments that may surface more interesting opportunities
secondary_value.evidence_span: just by being there and seeing what we learn, we may bump into even more interesting opportunities

causal_links.evidence_span: we're basically going to build products in those areas
take him with you, to build your very own custom gnome
drag and drop to really work between devices

notes: Playful pitch with weak explicit primary value—inferred from cool pocket-gnome framing. Lab strategy retained as singleton domain (independent learning claim). Gnomes vs Lyft device interconnect treated as separately revisable experiments. No commercial model stated.
